sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Csomag (packet) works exactly like kiló and üveg — it's a container/unit word that sits between egy and the noun, and only the noun takes -t.

items.english: I'd like a packet of butter.

sections.content: Prices are usually given per kiló, as in Egy kiló három forint — no accusative needed here since there's no verb of asking or requesting.
